summary: A year after Maria falls, the government spends lives to save food. Eren, Mikasa, and Armin enter training, and Eren fails the gear until he sees his own mistake.

segments.ja: ウォール・マリアが落ちてから、一年が経ちます。経った世界は、ローゼの内側に人を詰め込みます。詰め込んだ結果、パンが足りません。足りないパンを、役人は計算で割ります。割る対象は、シガンシナから来た難民です。難民の一部を、落ちた壁のほうへ返せば、残る口は減る、という考えです。考えは、奪還という名前を着ています。着ている名前の下で、送られる人は戻らない前提です。前提を、エレンは配給の列で聞きます。
segments.en: A year passes after Wall Maria falls. The world that has passed packs people inside Rose. As a result of the packing, there is not enough bread. Officials divide the insufficient bread by calculation. The target of the division is the refugees who came from Shiganshina. The idea is that if some of the refugees are sent back toward the fallen wall, the mouths that remain will decrease. The idea wears the name of a retaking. Under the name it wears, the people who are sent are assumed not to return. Eren hears the assumption in the ration line.

segments.ja: エレンは、訓練兵団の募集に自分の名を書きます。書く理由は、パンの計算に殺される側で終わることを拒む、です。拒む隣で、ミカサも同じ紙に名を置きます。置く理由は、エレンの誓いを一人にしない、です。アルミンは、体が兵に向いていないことを知っています。知っていても、二人を残して内側の安全には行きません。行かない選択が、本の少年の決断です。決断の三人は、まだ巨人の倒し方を知りません。
segments.en: Eren writes his own name on the Training Corps recruitment. The reason he writes it is to refuse ending on the side that the bread calculation kills. Beside the refusal, Mikasa puts her name on the same paper. The reason she puts it is not to leave Eren's vow as one person's. Armin knows his body is not suited to a soldier. Even knowing that, he does not go to safety inside and leave the two of them. The choice not to go is the decision of the boy with the book. The three of the decision do not yet know how to bring a Titan down.

segments.ja: 訓練所の教官は、キース・シャディスです。キースは、調査兵団の元兵士で、新兵の頭を刈ります。刈る刃の前で、彼は一人ひとりの目を見ます。見る目の中に、イェーガーの名があります。ある名を、彼は知っています。知っている過去を、今日は口にしません。しないまま、エレンの熱だけを記録します。記録する熱は、普通の復讐より濃いです。濃い生徒を、彼は特別扱いしません。しないことが、教官の公平です。公平の下で、三年が始まります。
segments.en: The instructor at the training ground is Keith Shadis. Keith is a former Survey Corps soldier, and he cuts the recruits' heads. In front of the blade that cuts, he looks at each person's eyes. Among the eyes he looks at is the name Jaeger. He knows the name that is there. He does not put the past he knows into his mouth today. Without putting it, he records only Eren's heat. The heat he records is thicker than ordinary revenge. He does not give special treatment to the student who is thick with it. Not giving it is the instructor's fairness. Under the fairness, three years begin.

segments.ja: 立体機動装置の初日は、空を飛ぶ日ではありません。ではありません。腰のベルトで体を吊り、バランスを取る試験です。試験の棒に、多くの新兵がぶら下がります。ぶら下がるエレンは、すぐに体が裏返ります。裏返る失敗を、ジャンは見ています。見ているジャンは、自分のバランスを少し自慢します。自慢の横で、ミカサは最初から安定しています。安定する彼女を、教官は無表情で通過させます。通過できないエレンは、地面に近い恥を知ります。
segments.en: The first day of the ODM gear is not a day of flying through the sky. It is not. It is a test of hanging the body from the belt at the waist and keeping balance. Many recruits hang from the bar of the test. Eren, hanging, immediately turns upside down. Jean is watching the failure of turning over. The Jean who is watching boasts a little of his own balance. Beside the boast, Mikasa is steady from the start. The instructor lets her, steady, pass with no expression. Eren, who cannot pass, learns a shame close to the ground.

segments.en: Annie Leonhart repeats a solo movement at the edge of the training. The kick she repeats differs a little from the corps' basics. The instructor does not cut the different movement as cheating. The reason he does not cut it is that the result is steady. She, steady, does not enter the circle of friends. Eren once sees the not-entering as a cold personality. The once he sees is still shallow. With the shallow view left as it is, three years place her technique above the class.

segments.en: Jean Kirstein is aiming at a safe post inside the walls. The reason he aims at it is that a bed with the interior police is better than wings that die outside. He says better, honestly. Eren calls the honesty he says cowardice. The opposition of that calling becomes daily life at the training ground. Inside the daily life, Jean admits Mikasa's strength and is irritated at the same time. The feeling of irritation is competition. Because there is competition, the class does not become only one person's anger.

segments.en: On the night of the bunks, Eren talks about the outside again. The talk he gives is the sea, and the width outside the walls. Armin supplements the width with the old book. The voice that supplements is smaller than a year ago. The reason it is smaller is that the sea has been placed beside his mother's death. Even beside that placement, the two do not throw the words away. The curiosity they do not throw away is a dim light inside despair. The light is not yet a guarantee that they can win. Even without a guarantee, there are people he can talk to after the fatigue of training.

segments.en: This episode shows only the entrance of the three years. At the entrance it shows, Eren fails the gear, fixes it, and returns to the line. In the line he returned to, the later names are already gathered. The names that are gathered are still friends. Meals, punishments, and the balance bar come before the war of Titans. The daily life that comes first makes soldiers. Keith watches the process of making them in silence. The eyes that watch are measuring how far the Jaeger child will continue.
